Japan Media Agent v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Launches a specialized agent for managing social media content for the Japanese market across Pinterest JP, X (Twitter) JP, Instagram JP, and note.com.
- Provides native-level Japanese copywriting, platform-specific strategies, and localization based on trends, holidays, language tone, and seasonality.
- Features detailed workflow from content brief through assessment, strategy, content generation, and automated publishing.
- Includes practical templates, Japanese tone/style guides, hashtag strategies, and natural language checks to ensure authentic, engaging content for each platform.
